Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a compact spot illustration for a lesson card in an English learning app. Create original black-and-white editorial line art with the clarity and wit of minimalist productivity-app illustrations. Confident slightly irregular hand-inked outlines, simple expressive adult characters, a few solid near-black shapes for hair or clothing, white interior fills, generous negative space. Near-black ink #1B2633 and white only. No colour, no grey shading, no gradients, no paper texture, no soft shadows. Friendly and quietly playful, not childish. A single very simple scene, readable when displayed at only 120 by 90 pixels. Compact horizontal composition within a square canvas, subject fills about 85 percent of width and 70 percent of height, even padding and all limbs fully inside the frame. Genuinely transparent background outside the character and props. No text, letters, numbers, logos, frames, badges or decorative sparkles. No busy setting or small background objects. Strong readable contour and clean transparent edges.
Subject: One curious adult with short curly black hair and a loose striped top, seen from the waist up at a small open photo album, holding one oversized printed snapshot and looking at it with a warm remembering expression. Two simple large snapshot shapes in total. The photograph has only a minimal mountain outline, no fine details. Clear head, hands and album silhouette; a scene about remembering and telling a past story.
